review:
Book of Kingdoms combines a 5x3, 25-payline book slot with a money respin feature. The book symbol plays its usual role, while a silver coin adds a second route to wins.

When it lands, the silver coin can either hit with the value of the Mega Jackpot, worth up to 1,000x your bet, or start the Money Respin feature, in which the values of all money symbols are added up and paid out. Having a jackpot element alongside the book mechanic gives the game more variety than a pure expanding-symbol slot. Pragmatic Play doesn't state an overall max win on the page. The RTP of 96.69% is one of the higher figures in this batch.
pros: Second route to big wins via respins or jackpots
Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Provider doesn't publish a volatility rating
No confirmed official max win figure
Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
